summary.text: Duane Quam is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 24A, with a tenure beginning in 2011, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Quam is an engineer with degrees in physics.

paragraphs.text: Duane Quam was born in Rochester, Minnesota, and lives in Byron, Minnesota.
He earned a B.S. and an M.S. in physics from the University of Texas at Dallas, and his career experience includes working as an engineer.
Quam has served as chairman of the Minnesota State Academic Science Standards writing committee and on the Byron School Board.
Ballotpedia lists Quam's tenure in the Minnesota House as beginning in 2011, and says he assumed office in District 24A on January 3, 2023.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Education Finance, Elections Finance and Policy (as co-chair) and State Government Finance and Policy committees.
